literature_notes: All six ledger lines were evaluated. L1–L5 (PMC7349057 and PMC11007909) describe Myc and mCherry tags placed at the C-terminus of full-length, membrane-anchored mouse or human EMCN expressed in HRECs. EMCN is a type I single-pass transmembrane protein (TM: 192–212); its C-terminus (residues 213–261) is intracellular. These constructs are real, tolerated, membrane-anchored tagged proteins, but the tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface — they qualify only as other_positions (kind=intracellular). L6 (PMC9939191) reports a FLAG-tagged EMCN overexpression construct in SW480 cells but states no tag position whatsoever; it cannot be pinned to any residue and is disqualified. No ledger line supports an extracellular tag insertion for EMCN, so sites = [].

literature_other_positions.note: Myc + mCherry tags placed at the C-terminus of full-length membrane-anchored EMCN; residue 261 (N) is intracellular (topology 213–261), so this is a cytoplasmic tag, not a surface tag.
